summary.headline: Omens of the Earthy Triplicity
summary.text: Astrological omens for the earthy triplicity, describing the effects of Jupiter, Mars, Mercury, Saturn, and the Moon on weather, illness, marriage, prices, crops, animals, rulers, and social disorder. The discussion then begins Venus’s combustion in the airy triplicity and its effects on women, servants, western regions, and the fifth clime.
